prompt: Audita el tipo de oferta COHORT_BASED_COURSE. Tenemos varios cursos en cohorte y quiero asegurarme de que el sistema captura todo lo que necesita el SDR para vender este tipo de programa.

assertions.text: Report focuses specifically on COHORT_BASED_COURSE, not generic offer advice. Mentions ProgramDetails, curriculum, cohort_limit, schedule, etc.
Reads and analyzes the ProgramDetails model including curriculum (ProgramModule), schedule (SessionDetails), cohort settings, and community fields
Applies Hormozi (Grand Slam Offer), WbD (Critical Event), and Casel (Productization) as primary frameworks — not primarily brand-level frameworks
Validates whether a complete Product Blueprint (Ficha Tecnica) can be assembled: Target/ICP, Critical Event, Promise of Impact, Process Steps, Guarantee/Bonuses
Includes program-specific SDR questions: duration, start date, waitlist, curriculum structure, live interaction format
Checks whether the offer inherits brand data (voice, story, positioning, proof) and flags gaps in the brand-to-offer data bridge
